definition_zh: 放弃；抛弃；遗弃；放任；纵情
definition_en: to leave someone or something behind for good, or to give up an aim
core_image: 一个人把钥匙放在桌上，转身离开不再回来
scene: 雨夜里，他把车停在路边，锁上门，沿着公路走远。He decided to abandon the car and walk to the next town.
sceneCN: 这里的 abandon 指「抛弃；丢下」（第 1 个义项：把某物丢下不再管）；句意是他决定丢下车子，步行去下一个镇。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ment 构成，义为「放弃；遗弃」

senses.title: To give up an aim
senses.definition: stops trying to do or achieve something
senses.definitionCN: 停止尝试做某事或达成某个目标
senses.example: They had to abandon the climb before dark.
senses.exampleCN: 他们不得不在天黑前放弃登顶。
senses.why: The oldest French sense is to hand something over, and giving up a plan is handing it away.
senses.whyCN: 古法语最古老的意思是「交出去」，放弃计划就是把计划交出去。

senses.title: To leave someone behind
senses.definition: leaves a person without help or support
senses.definitionCN: 丢下某人，不再给予帮助或支持
senses.example: He would never abandon a friend in trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 他绝不会抛弃陷入困境的朋友。
senses.why: To surrender control of a person is to stop standing by them.
senses.whyCN: 把一个人交出去不管，就是不再站在他身边。

senses.title: To desert a place
senses.definition: leaves a building, town or vehicle and does not return
senses.definitionCN: 离开房屋、城镇或车辆且不再回来
senses.example: The villagers abandon their homes when the river rises.
senses.exampleCN: 河水上涨时，村民会弃家而走。
senses.why: A place handed over to itself stands empty, so the verb covers deserted houses and towns.
senses.whyCN: 被交还给自己的地方就空了下来，动词因此涵盖弃屋与弃城。

senses.title: To give up a claim
senses.definition: formally gives up a right, claim or plan
senses.definitionCN: 正式放弃某项权利、主张或计划
senses.example: The company agreed to abandon the lawsuit.
senses.exampleCN: 公司同意放弃这场诉讼。
senses.why: Legal surrender is the literal old sense, still visible in claims and lawsuits.
senses.whyCN: 法律上的让与正是古老的直义，在权利主张与诉讼里仍看得见。

senses.title: To let oneself go
senses.definition: in abandon oneself to, gives way completely to a feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在 abandon oneself to 中完全沉入某种情感
senses.example: She abandoned herself to grief for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 她放任自己悲伤了一个星期。
senses.why: Giving up control of oneself produces the reflexive pattern and the noun abandon.
senses.whyCN: 放弃对自己的控制，便生出反身句型和名词 abandon。

senses.title: To leave a ship
senses.definition: leaves a ship that is in danger
senses.definitionCN: 离开处于危险中的船只
senses.example: The crew had to abandon the sinking ship.
senses.exampleCN: 船员不得不弃掉正在下沉的船。
senses.why: The call abandon ship is the oldest practical use, when a vessel can no longer be saved.
senses.whyCN: 弃船令是最古老的实用场景：船已无法挽救。

senses.title: Complete lack of restraint
senses.definition: in the phrase with abandon, acts freely and without shyness
senses.definitionCN: 在 with abandon 中自由自在、毫不拘束地行动
senses.example: The children danced with abandon in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在雨中尽情跳舞。
senses.why: A person who has surrendered caution moves without holding back, and the noun names that freedom.
senses.whyCN: 放下了谨慎的人不再收着，名词便指这种自由。

senses.title: To stop maintaining something
senses.definition: stops looking after or continuing something
senses.definitionCN: 停止照管或继续某事
senses.example: The council will abandon the old road next year.
senses.exampleCN: 议会明年将不再维护这条旧路。
senses.why: Upkeep is a kind of hold on a thing, and letting go of it is another branch of the same idea.
senses.whyCN: 维护也是对事物的把持，放手不管便是同一观念的另一分支。

intro.en: The word came into English from French, where it meant to put something under someone else's control.
intro.cn: 这个词经法语进入英语，原意是「把某物交到别人掌控之下」。

items.en: a bandon meant at one's disposal or under one's control.
items.cn: a bandon 意为「听凭处置、在他人掌控之下」。

items.en: abandoner meant to give something over to another's power.
items.cn: abandoner 意为把某物交给他人支配。

items.en: abandonen entered English with the sense of handing over or surrendering.
items.cn: abandonen 进入英语时意为交出、让与。

items.en: the sense shifted from surrendering to leaving something behind.
items.cn: 词义从「让与」转为「丢下不管」。

items.en: abandon now covers giving up plans, people and places.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖放弃计划、抛弃他人与遗弃地方。

items.en: the noun with abandon names a careless freedom.
items.cn: 名词搭配 with abandon 指一种无所拘束的自由。

note.en: The look-alike group is the abandon family; the near-meaning group is other verbs of leaving.
note.cn: 形近组是 abandon 词族；近义组是别的表示「离开、舍弃」的动词。

definition_zh: 能力；才能；本领；胜任力
definition_en: the power or skill to do something
core_image: 一个人踮起脚，刚好够到高处的架子
scene: 面试时，她用一个具体项目说明自己能做什么。The interview let her show her ability to lead a team.
sceneCN: 这里的 ability 指「能力」（第 1 个义项：做某事的力量或本领）；句意是面试让她展示了自己带领团队的能力。

collocations.phrase: to the best of one's ability

senses.title: Power to do something
senses.definition: the power to perform a task
senses.definitionCN: 完成某项任务的力量
senses.example: She has the ability to solve hard problems quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 她有迅速解决难题的能力。
senses.why: The Latin root means fitness for a task, and fitness is the core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「适合某项任务」，适合正是这个词的核心。

senses.title: A learned skill
senses.definition: a skill gained through training or practice
senses.definitionCN: 通过训练或练习获得的技能
senses.example: His ability in mathematics won him a scholarship.
senses.exampleCN: 他的数学才能为他赢得了奖学金。
senses.why: Fitness can be trained, so the word also names cultivated skills.
senses.whyCN: 「适合」可以训练出来，因此这个词也指培养出的技能。

senses.title: Physical capacity
senses.definition: the body's power to move or act
senses.definitionCN: 身体活动或行动的力量
senses.example: The injury limited her ability to walk.
senses.exampleCN: 伤势限制了她行走的能力。
senses.why: The body is the first thing a task demands, so physical power is an early sense.
senses.whyCN: 身体是完成任务的第一要件，体力因此是较早的义项。

senses.title: Mental capacity
senses.definition: the mind's power to understand and reason
senses.definitionCN: 理解与推理的心智力量
senses.example: The test measures the ability to reason under pressure.
senses.exampleCN: 这项测试衡量在压力下推理的能力。
senses.why: Reasoning is a kind of fitness too, so the word extends to the mind.
senses.whyCN: 推理也是一种「适合」，词义便延伸到心智。

senses.title: Legal capacity
senses.definition: the legal right to perform an act
senses.definitionCN: 实施某行为所需的法定资格
senses.example: The court questioned his ability to sign the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 法院质疑他签署合同的行为能力。
senses.why: Law asks whether a person is fit to act, using the same old idea.
senses.whyCN: 法律问的是一个人是否适合行动，用的还是同一个古老观念。

senses.title: Financial capacity
senses.definition: the means to pay for something
senses.definitionCN: 支付某物所需的经济条件
senses.example: The bank checked the company's ability to repay.
senses.exampleCN: 银行核查了公司的偿还能力。
senses.why: Money is a means to act, so the word covers the power to pay.
senses.whyCN: 钱是行动的手段，因此这个词也涵盖支付的力量。

senses.title: Natural talent
senses.definition: an inborn power that makes learning easy
senses.definitionCN: 使学习变得容易的先天力量
senses.example: The coach spotted the boy's natural ability at once.
senses.exampleCN: 教练一眼就看出了这男孩的天赋。
senses.why: Some fitness comes without training, and the word marks that gift.
senses.whyCN: 有些「适合」无需训练就有，这个词便标出这份天赋。

senses.title: Practical feasibility
senses.definition: whether a task lies within someone's power
senses.definitionCN: 某项任务是否在某人的力量范围之内
senses.example: The task is within the ability of a small team.
senses.exampleCN: 这项任务在一个小团队的能力范围内。
senses.why: Asked whether a job can be done, the word measures the fit between task and power.
senses.whyCN: 当问一件工作能否做成时，这个词衡量的正是任务与力量之间的匹配。

intro.en: The word is built on a Latin adjective for something handy or fit.
intro.cn: 这个词建在一个表示「顺手、适合」的拉丁语形容词上。

items.en: habilis meant handy or fit, from habere, to hold.
items.cn: habilis 意为「顺手的、适合的」，源自 habere（持有）。

items.en: habilitas named the quality of being fit for something.
items.cn: habilitas 指「适合某事」的品质。

items.en: ablete carried the sense of skill and fitness.
items.cn: 古法语 ablete 承接了技能与适合之义。

items.en: abilite entered English as the state of being able.
items.cn: abilite 进入英语，指「有能力」的状态。

items.en: the plural abilities names several skills at once.
items.cn: 复数 abilities 同时指多项技能。

note.en: The look-alike group is the able family; the near-meaning group is other words for power and skill.
note.cn: 形近组是 able 词族；近义组是别的表示力量与技能的词。

abstract.en: Think of a runner finding an easy rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象跑者找到了轻松的节奏。

examples.cn: 她有在压力下保持镇定的能力。

examples.en: The course develops the ability to write clearly.

examples.en: His abilities were never in doubt.
examples.cn: 他的能力从未受到怀疑。

definition_zh: 能够的；有能力的；能干的
definition_en: having the power, skill or chance to do something
core_image: 一只手把重物稳稳举到肩上
scene: 修理工蹲下看了看，说这台旧机器还能修好。The mechanic said the old machine was still able to run.
sceneCN: 这里的 able 指「能够的」（第 1 个义项：具备做某事的能力）；句意是修理工说这台旧机器还能运转。

pos.zh: 能够的；有能力的；能干的

senses.title: Having the power to do
senses.definition: has the strength or means to do something
senses.definitionCN: 具备做某事的力量或手段
senses.example: She is able to lift the box on her own.
senses.exampleCN: 她一个人就能提起这只箱子。
senses.why: The root means handy or fit, and the first sense is simply being fit for the task.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「顺手、适合」，第一个义项就是「适合这项任务」。

senses.title: Skilled or competent
senses.definition: does a job with skill and good judgement
senses.definitionCN: 以技能和良好判断完成工作
senses.example: He is an able manager who listens.
senses.exampleCN: 他是一位善于倾听的能干经理。
senses.why: Fitness grows into general competence, so the adjective praises ability.
senses.whyCN: 「适合」长成一般的胜任，形容词便用来称赞能力。

senses.title: Having the chance
senses.definition: has the opportunity to do something
senses.definitionCN: 拥有做某事的机会
senses.example: We were able to leave early that day.
senses.exampleCN: 那天我们得以提早离开。
senses.why: Circumstance can make an act possible, so able also reports opportunity.
senses.whyCN: 环境也能让行动成为可能，因此 able 也用来报告机会。

senses.title: Physically fit
senses.definition: in able-bodied, has a sound and working body
senses.definitionCN: 在 able-bodied 中表示身体健全、行动自如
senses.example: The able-bodied passengers helped the others.
senses.exampleCN: 身体健全的乘客帮助了其他人。
senses.why: Bodily fitness is the plainest kind of being able, and the compound keeps it.
senses.whyCN: 体格健全是最朴素的「能够」，复合词把它保留下来。

senses.title: Legally qualified
senses.definition: meets the legal conditions for an act
senses.definitionCN: 符合实施某行为的法定条件
senses.example: Any person able to vote may stand for the post.
senses.exampleCN: 任何有投票资格的人都可以竞选该职位。
senses.why: Law asks who is fit to act, and the old word supplies the answer.
senses.whyCN: 法律问谁有资格行动，这个古老的词正好提供答案。

senses.title: Good at a task
senses.definition: performs a particular activity well
senses.definitionCN: 在某项活动中表现出色
senses.example: She is an able swimmer.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一位游泳好手。
senses.why: A person fit for one activity is called able in that activity.
senses.whyCN: 适合某项活动的人，就在那项活动上被称作 able。

senses.title: A nautical rank
senses.definition: in able seaman, a fully trained deck rating
senses.definitionCN: 在 able seaman 中，指训练有素的甲板水兵
senses.example: He served as an able seaman for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 他当了两年的 一等水兵。
senses.why: A sailor certified fit for all deck work carries the word in his rank.
senses.whyCN: 被认定能胜任全部甲板工作的水手，把这个词带进了职衔。

senses.title: A suffix-forming element
senses.definition: in grammar, the ending that makes adjectives such as readable
senses.definitionCN: 语法上构成 readable 这类形容词的词尾
senses.example: The ending able forms words such as readable.
senses.exampleCN: 词尾 able 构成 readable 这样的词。
senses.why: The same Latin root became a productive suffix meaning fit to be.
senses.whyCN: 同一个拉丁词根变成能产的词尾，意为「可以被……的」。

definition_zh: 在船（车、飞机）上；上船（车、飞机）
definition_en: on or onto a ship, train, aircraft or other vehicle
core_image: 一个人踏上舷梯，手扶着栏杆
scene: 码头上，旅客提着箱子依次走上舷梯。The passengers were already aboard when the whistle blew.
sceneCN: 这里的 aboard 指「在船上」（第 1 个义项：处于船、车或飞机之上）；句意是汽笛响时乘客已经在船上了。

derivatives.zh: 义为「随车携带的；入职的」

senses.title: On a ship
senses.definition: in or on a ship
senses.definitionCN: 在船体之内或船板之上
senses.example: The passengers were already aboard when the whistle blew.
senses.exampleCN: 汽笛响时乘客已经在船上了。
senses.why: The oldest phrase was on bord, upon the ship's deck, and aboard still means that.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的说法是 on bord，即「在船板上」，aboard 至今仍是这个意思。

senses.title: Onto a ship
senses.definition: moving onto a ship
senses.definitionCN: 移动到船上
senses.example: The last guests came aboard at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一批客人在中午上了船。
senses.why: The same word covers position and movement, as many place words do.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词兼指位置与移动，许多方位词都是如此。

senses.title: On a train or plane
senses.definition: in or on a train, bus or aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 在火车、公共汽车或飞机上
senses.example: No smoking is allowed aboard the aircraft.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机上禁止吸烟。
senses.why: Once ships named the pattern, every large vehicle inherited the word.
senses.whyCN: 船先立下了这个说法，各种大型交通工具便都继承了它。

senses.title: The call to board
senses.definition: in all aboard, the shout that departure is near
senses.definitionCN: 在 all aboard 中，提示即将出发的呼号
senses.example: The guard shouted all aboard just before the doors closed.
senses.exampleCN: 车门关闭前，列车员喊了一声「全部上车」。
senses.why: A call to be on board became a fixed announcement, and the word kept it.
senses.whyCN: 叫大家上船的话成了固定广播，这个词便保留下来。

senses.title: Welcome to a group
senses.definition: in welcome aboard, an invitation to join a team
senses.definitionCN: 在 welcome aboard 中，表示欢迎加入一个团队
senses.example: The captain welcomed the new engineer aboard.
senses.exampleCN: 船长欢迎新工程师加入。
senses.why: A crew is a company on a ship, so joining any team borrows the nautical welcome.
senses.whyCN: 船员是船上的一群人，加入任何团队都借用了这句航海欢迎。

senses.title: Near a ship
senses.definition: in close aboard, lying near a vessel's side
senses.definitionCN: 在 close aboard 中，指靠近船侧
senses.example: The pilot boat stood close aboard.
senses.exampleCN: 引航艇紧靠着大船。
senses.why: Being at the side of a ship is a specialised extension of being on it.
senses.whyCN: 处在船侧是「在船上」的一个专门延伸。

senses.title: On a spacecraft
senses.definition: in or on a spacecraft or space station
senses.definitionCN: 在航天器或空间站上
senses.example: The crew slept aboard the station for six months.
senses.exampleCN: 机组在空间站上睡了六个月。
senses.why: Spacecraft are ships in name and in practice, so the word travels with them.
senses.whyCN: 航天器在名称与实操上都像船，这个词便随之前往。

senses.title: To take something in
senses.definition: in take aboard, to load cargo or accept an idea
senses.definitionCN: 在 take aboard 中，指装载货物或接受某种想法
senses.example: The team took the new idea aboard after a long debate.
senses.exampleCN: 经过长时间讨论，团队采纳了这个新想法。
senses.why: Loading a ship and accepting an idea are both taking something on board.
senses.whyCN: 往船上装货与接受一个想法，都是「把东西接到船上」。

definition_zh: 废除；废止；取消（法律、制度或习俗）
definition_en: to end a law, system or practice officially
core_image: 一份旧法令被盖上「作废」的印章
scene: 议会投票之后，延续百年的旧税制被正式取消。The parliament voted to abolish the old tax.
sceneCN: 这里的 abolish 指「废除」（第 1 个义项：正式终止法律或制度）；句意是议会投票废除这项旧税。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ition 构成，义为「废除；废止」
义为「废奴主义者；主张废除者」

senses.title: To end a law officially
senses.definition: formally brings a law or rule to an end
senses.definitionCN: 正式使某项法律或规则终止
senses.example: The parliament voted to abolish the old tax.
senses.exampleCN: 议会投票废除了这项旧税。
senses.why: The Latin root means to wipe out, and a law wiped from the books no longer applies.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「抹去」，从法典里抹去的法律便不再生效。

senses.title: To end slavery
senses.definition: puts an end to the owning of people
senses.definitionCN: 终止蓄养人口的做法
senses.example: The movement to abolish slavery grew through the century.
senses.exampleCN: 废除奴隶制的运动在这一百年间壮大。
senses.why: The word's most famous use names the ending of an institution people had accepted.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最著名的用法，就是终结一项曾被人接受的制度。

senses.title: To cancel a fee
senses.definition: removes a charge or duty that people had to pay
senses.definitionCN: 取消人们原本必须缴纳的费用或税项
senses.example: The city decided to abolish the parking fee.
senses.exampleCN: 市政府决定取消停车费。
senses.why: A charge written into rules can be struck out like any other rule.
senses.whyCN: 写进规章的收费，可以像别的规章一样被划掉。

senses.title: To end a custom
senses.definition: stops a long-standing practice in a society
senses.definitionCN: 终止社会上长期存在的做法
senses.example: It is hard to abolish a custom that families keep privately.
senses.exampleCN: 要废止各家私下沿袭的习俗很难。
senses.why: Customs are unwritten laws, and the verb reaches them too.
senses.whyCN: 习俗是不成文的法，这个动词也能触及它们。

senses.title: To close an institution
senses.definition: ends the existence of an official body
senses.definitionCN: 使某个官方机构不再存在
senses.example: The reform will abolish two small agencies.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革将撤销两个小机构。
senses.why: An institution exists by decree, so ending the decree ends the body.
senses.whyCN: 机构因法令而存在，终止法令便终止了机构。

senses.title: To end a punishment
senses.definition: removes a penalty from the legal code
senses.definitionCN: 从法典中取消某种刑罚
senses.example: Several states voted to abolish the death penalty.
senses.exampleCN: 几个州投票废除了死刑。
senses.why: A penalty is a clause in the code, and striking the clause abolishes it.
senses.whyCN: 刑罚是法典中的条款，删去条款就是废除。

senses.title: To drop a rule in sport
senses.definition: removes an old rule from the rules of a game
senses.definitionCN: 从比赛规则中删去旧条款
senses.example: The league voted to abolish the old offside rule.
senses.exampleCN: 联盟投票取消了旧的越位规则。
senses.why: Games are governed by written rules, and the word applies wherever rules are written.
senses.whyCN: 比赛由成文规则管理，凡有成文规则处都能用这个词。

senses.title: To annul a contract
senses.definition: in law, makes an agreement of no effect
senses.definitionCN: 法律上使某项协议失效
senses.example: The court may abolish the clause if it is unfair.
senses.exampleCN: 若条款不公，法院可废止该条款。
senses.why: Wiping out an obligation is the legal face of the same old idea.
senses.whyCN: 抹去一项义务，正是同一古老观念在法律上的面貌。

items.en: abolisshen entered English with the sense of doing away with.

definition_zh: 流产；堕胎；人工流产；（计划等的）夭折
definition_en: the ending of a pregnancy, or the failure of a plan before it develops
core_image: 一株刚发芽的苗被移出花盆
scene: 诊所里，医生用平实的语言说明终止妊娠的风险。The clinic explained the risks of abortion in plain language.
sceneCN: 这里的 abortion 指「人工流产」（第 1 个义项：人为终止妊娠）；句意是诊所把人工流产的风险讲得很明白。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ive 构成，义为「失败的；夭折的」

senses.title: The ending of a pregnancy
senses.definition: the ending of a pregnancy before the fetus can survive
senses.definitionCN: 胎儿尚不能存活时妊娠终止
senses.example: The clinic explained the risks of abortion in plain language.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所把人工流产的风险讲得很明白。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to miscarry, and the noun names that ending.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「小产」，名词便指这一终止。

senses.title: A medical procedure
senses.definition: a procedure chosen to end a pregnancy
senses.definitionCN: 人为选择终止妊娠的医疗操作
senses.example: The law sets out when an abortion may be performed.
senses.exampleCN: 法律规定何时可以施行人工流产。
senses.why: Once medicine could perform it safely, the word named the procedure itself.
senses.whyCN: 医学能安全施行之后，这个词便指这项手术。

senses.title: A natural loss
senses.definition: in medicine, the body's own loss of a pregnancy
senses.definitionCN: 医学上指身体自行失去妊娠
senses.example: Doctors call this kind of loss a spontaneous abortion.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把这类失去称为自然流产。
senses.why: The oldest medical sense covers any pregnancy that ends early, however it happens.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的医学义涵盖一切提早结束的妊娠，无论原因如何。

senses.title: A plan that fails
senses.definition: the failure of a scheme before it is carried out
senses.definitionCN: 计划在实施之前就失败
senses.example: The project was an abortion from the start.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目从一开始就注定夭折。
senses.why: Something cut off before it can live is the image behind the figurative use.
senses.whyCN: 在能成活之前就被截断，正是这一比喻义的意象。

senses.title: A mission cut short
senses.definition: the stopping of a flight or mission before completion
senses.definitionCN: 飞行或任务在完成前被中止
senses.example: The launch was an abortion after the fuel leak.
senses.exampleCN: 燃料泄漏之后，这次发射成了一次中止。
senses.why: Engineering borrowed the medical word for anything halted before its end.
senses.whyCN: 工程界借用了这个医学词，指任何中途停止之事。

senses.title: A stunted organ
senses.definition: in botany, a part that stops developing
senses.definitionCN: 植物学上指停止发育的部分
senses.example: The flower shows abortion of the stamens.
senses.exampleCN: 这朵花表现出雄蕊发育不全。
senses.why: A part that never reaches full form is a pregnancy that never comes to term.
senses.whyCN: 未能长成的部分，正如未能足月的妊娠。

senses.title: A public controversy
senses.definition: the word used in debates about the legal right to end a pregnancy
senses.definitionCN: 在关于终止妊娠的法律权利辩论中所用的词
senses.example: Abortion remains a central issue in the election.
senses.exampleCN: 堕胎仍是这次选举的核心议题。
senses.why: A medical term becomes a political label when law and morals take it up.
senses.whyCN: 当法律与道德介入，医学词便成了政治标签。

senses.title: An imperfect result
senses.definition: something badly made or left unfinished
senses.definitionCN: 制作粗劣或未完成的事物
senses.example: The report was a rushed abortion of a draft.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告是一份草率仓促的稿子。
senses.why: The idea of something born too soon extends to any botched work.
senses.whyCN: 「出生太早」的观念延伸到任何做坏的东西。

definition_zh: 关于；大约；在……附近；即将
definition_en: on the subject of something, or approximately
core_image: 一个圈把话题围在中间
scene: 会上，大家围绕预算谈了很久。The meeting was about the budget for next year.
sceneCN: 这里的 about 指「关于」（第 1 个义项：涉及某个话题）；句意是这场会议讨论的是明年的预算。

derivatives.zh: 义为「（立场等的）大转变；向后转」

senses.title: On the subject of
senses.definition: concerned with a particular subject
senses.definitionCN: 涉及某个特定话题
senses.example: The meeting was about the budget for next year.
senses.exampleCN: 这场会议讨论的是明年的预算。
senses.why: The old phrase meant around, and a talk around a subject is a talk about it.
senses.whyCN: 古短语意为「在……周围」，围绕一个话题谈就是谈论它。

senses.title: Approximately
senses.definition: near a number or amount but not exact
senses.definitionCN: 接近某个数量但不精确
senses.example: The journey takes about two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这段路程大约要两个小时。
senses.why: Being around a figure in space became being near it in number.
senses.whyCN: 在空间上「在周围」，变成在数量上「接近」。

senses.title: In the vicinity
senses.definition: in the area around a place
senses.definitionCN: 在某地周围的区域
senses.example: There were few houses about the village.
senses.exampleCN: 村子周围没有几户人家。
senses.why: The oldest sense is literally on the outside or around, and place is its home.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思就是「在外围、在四周」，地方是它的本域。

senses.title: On the point of
senses.definition: in be about to, ready to do something very soon
senses.definitionCN: 在 be about to 中，表示马上就要做某事
senses.example: She was about to leave when the phone rang.
senses.exampleCN: 她正要离开，电话响了。
senses.why: A thing arranged around the next moment is on the edge of happening.
senses.whyCN: 事情已经围着下一刻安排好了，就在发生的边缘。

senses.title: All around
senses.definition: in every direction or in many places
senses.definitionCN: 朝各个方向或在许多地方
senses.example: Papers were lying about the room.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里到处散着纸张。
senses.why: The spatial core of the word is a scattering around a centre.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的空间核心，就是围绕中心散开。

senses.title: Occupied with
senses.definition: in be about something, busy with an activity
senses.definitionCN: 在 be about 中，表示正忙于某项活动
senses.example: He is about his father's business.
senses.exampleCN: 他正忙着父亲的那摊生意。
senses.why: To be around a task is to be engaged in it.
senses.whyCN: 围着某件事转，就是在做这件事。

senses.title: In circulation
senses.definition: in the phrase have about one, carried nearby
senses.definitionCN: 在 have about one 中，表示随身带着
senses.example: She had a pencil about her.
senses.exampleCN: 她身上带着一支铅笔。
senses.why: What is around a person is what they carry with them.
senses.whyCN: 围在一个人周围的东西，就是他随身带着的东西。

senses.title: A reversal of direction
senses.definition: in about-face, a turn to the opposite direction or view
senses.definitionCN: 在 about-face 中，指向相反方向或立场转变
senses.example: The board did an about-face on the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会对这项计划来了个大转向。
senses.why: Turning about is turning around, and the phrase names a complete reversal.
senses.whyCN: turn about 就是转过身，短语便指彻底的逆转。

items.cn: abutan 意为「在……外面」或「在……周围」。

items.en: the form joined a-, be- and utan, outside.

items.cn: abouten 保留了「在某地周围」之义。

items.en: the word extended from place to number and subject.
items.cn: 词义从地点扩展到数量与话题。

items.en: about to and about-face fixed two special uses.
items.cn: about to 与 about-face 固定了两个特殊用法。

note.cn: 形近组共享 about 这一词形；近义组是表示约数与话题的词。

definition_zh: 在……上方；高于；超过；上述的
definition_en: at a higher level than something, or more than a number
core_image: 一只手抬起，指向头顶上方的位置
scene: 山脚下，气温很低，而雪线整个冬天都悬在村子上方。The snow line lay above the village all winter.
sceneCN: 这里的 above 指「在……上方」（第 1 个义项：位置高于某物）；句意是整个冬天雪线都悬在村子上方。

senses.title: Higher than
senses.definition: at a higher position than something
senses.definitionCN: 位置高于某物
senses.example: The snow line lay above the village all winter.
senses.exampleCN: 整个冬天雪线都悬在村子上方。
senses.why: The Old English form meant over, and physical height is its first sense.
senses.whyCN: 古英语词形意为「在上方」，物理高度是它的第一个义项。

senses.title: More than a number
senses.definition: greater than a particular amount or level
senses.definitionCN: 大于某个数量或水平
senses.example: Temperatures stayed above zero all week.
senses.exampleCN: 整个星期气温都在零度以上。
senses.why: Higher in space becomes higher on a scale, which is the same relation.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的更高变成刻度上的更高，关系是一样的。

senses.title: Higher in rank
senses.definition: of greater rank or importance than another
senses.definitionCN: 级别或重要性高于他人
senses.example: A captain is above a lieutenant.
senses.exampleCN: 上尉的军衔高于中尉。
senses.why: Rank is pictured as a ladder, and whoever stands higher is above.
senses.whyCN: 等级被想象成梯子，站得更高的人就在上方。

senses.title: Earlier in a text
senses.definition: used to refer to something written earlier
senses.definitionCN: 用来指前文写过的事物
senses.example: See the table above for the full figures.
senses.exampleCN: 完整数字见上表。
senses.why: The earlier part of a page is physically higher, so the word points backward in reading.
senses.whyCN: 页面前面部分位置更高，这个词便指阅读中的前文。

senses.title: More than all else
senses.definition: in above all, more than anything else
senses.definitionCN: 在 above all 中，表示胜过其他一切
senses.example: Above all, keep the records safe.
senses.exampleCN: 最重要的是把记录保管好。
senses.why: What stands above everything else is what matters most.
senses.whyCN: 高于一切的东西，就是最重要的东西。

senses.title: Beyond reproach
senses.definition: in above suspicion, too honest to be doubted
senses.definitionCN: 在 above suspicion 中，指清白得无可怀疑
senses.example: Her conduct was above suspicion.
senses.exampleCN: 她的行为无可怀疑。
senses.why: Being above something is being out of its reach, including doubt.
senses.whyCN: 在某物之上就是够不着它，怀疑也是如此。

senses.title: Too proud for
senses.definition: in above doing something, unwilling to stoop to it
senses.definitionCN: 在 above doing something 中，指不屑于做某事
senses.example: He is above taking credit for others' work.
senses.exampleCN: 他不屑于把别人的功劳据为己有。
senses.why: A person above a petty act is morally higher than it.
senses.whyCN: 高于一件小动作的人，在道德上就压在它上面。

senses.title: Overhead in the sky
senses.definition: in or to a higher place, especially overhead
senses.definitionCN: 在或向更高的地方，尤指头顶上方
senses.example: A hawk circled above.
senses.exampleCN: 一只鹰在上空盘旋。
senses.why: The adverb keeps the plain spatial sense without naming what is below.
senses.whyCN: 副词形式保留了纯粹的空间义，不点明下方是什么。

definition_zh: 在国外；到国外；广泛地
definition_en: in or to a foreign country
core_image: 一张登机牌和一本护照摊在桌上
scene: 毕业之后，她决定去海外工作两年。After graduation she decided to work abroad for two years.
sceneCN: 这里的 abroad 指「在国外」（第 1 个义项：在外国）；句意是毕业后她决定去海外工作两年。

senses.title: In a foreign country
senses.definition: living or staying in another country
senses.definitionCN: 在另一个国家居住或停留
senses.example: After graduation she decided to work abroad for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 毕业后她决定去海外工作两年。
senses.why: The old word meant widely spread, and being spread into other lands became being overseas.
senses.whyCN: 古义是「散布得广」，散布到别的国土就成了在海外。

senses.title: To a foreign country
senses.definition: travelling or moving to another country
senses.definitionCN: 前往另一个国家
senses.example: He went abroad to study medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 他出国学医。
senses.why: The same adverb covers both position and direction, as many place words do.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词兼指位置与方向，许多方位词都是如此。

senses.title: Widely, far and near
senses.definition: over a wide area, in the older literary sense
senses.definitionCN: 在广阔范围内，属较早的书面义
senses.example: The news was soon spread abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 消息很快四处传开。
senses.why: The literal old sense is scattered wide, and it survives in formal writing.
senses.whyCN: 古老的字面义是「散得很广」，在正式书面语中仍有留存。

senses.title: Out of doors
senses.definition: in the open air, an archaic use
senses.definitionCN: 在露天，属古旧用法
senses.example: The children played abroad in the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在园子里的露天处玩耍。
senses.why: Being spread outside the house is the oldest spatial picture of the word.
senses.whyCN: 散到屋子之外，是这个词最古老的空间画面。

senses.title: In circulation
senses.definition: known or talked about by many people
senses.definitionCN: 被许多人知道或谈论
senses.example: Rumours of the change were abroad in the office.
senses.exampleCN: 关于变动的传言在办公室里流传。
senses.why: A rumour spreads wide like a seed, so the old sense of scattering fits.
senses.whyCN: 传言像种子一样散开，正合古老的「散布」义。

senses.title: Away from home
senses.definition: away from one's own home or country
senses.definitionCN: 离开自己的家或国家
senses.example: This is his first long stay abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 这是他第一次长期离家在外。
senses.why: Distance from home is the everyday face of being in another land.
senses.whyCN: 离家的距离，就是在异国的日常面貌。

senses.title: In all directions
senses.definition: out in various directions, as in older usage
senses.definitionCN: 向各个方向散开，属较早用法
senses.example: The seeds were carried abroad by the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 种子被风带向四方。
senses.why: Scattering in all directions is the physical root behind the overseas sense.
senses.whyCN: 向四方散开，是「海外」义背后的物理根源。

senses.title: Throughout a wide area
senses.definition: over a large region or among many people
senses.definitionCN: 遍及广大地区或众多人群
senses.example: The custom is common abroad in the countryside.
senses.exampleCN: 这种习俗在乡间各地很常见。
senses.why: A usage spread through a region keeps the ancient sense of breadth.
senses.whyCN: 遍布一地的用法，保留了古老的「广阔」义。

definition_zh: 缺席；不在；缺乏；没有
definition_en: the state of not being present, or the lack of something
core_image: 教室里一把空着的椅子
scene: 点名时，老师发现最后一排少了一个人。The teacher noticed his absence at roll call.
sceneCN: 这里的 absence 指「缺席」（第 1 个义项：人不在场）；句意是点名时老师发现他缺席。

senses.title: Not being present
senses.definition: the state of a person not being in a place
senses.definitionCN: 某人不在某处的状态
senses.example: The teacher noticed his absence at roll call.
senses.exampleCN: 点名时老师发现他缺席。
senses.why: The Latin noun names being away, and a missing person is the plainest case.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词指「不在」，缺席的人是最直白的例子。

senses.title: Lack of something
senses.definition: the state of not having something needed
senses.definitionCN: 缺少某样必需之物的状态
senses.example: The absence of clean water slowed the work.
senses.exampleCN: 缺乏干净的水拖慢了工作。
senses.why: If a thing is not there, it is absent, and the noun covers it as well as people.
senses.whyCN: 某物不在就是缺失，名词既指人也指物。

senses.title: A period away
senses.definition: a length of time spent away from a place
senses.definitionCN: 不在某地的一段时期
senses.example: After a long absence he returned to the town.
senses.exampleCN: 离开很久之后，他回到了镇上。
senses.why: Away is also a duration, so the noun measures the time of not being there.
senses.whyCN: 「不在」也有一段时长，名词便计量这段不在的时间。

senses.title: Absence of mind
senses.definition: in absence of mind, a lack of attention to what is happening
senses.definitionCN: 在 absence of mind 中，指对眼前之事缺乏注意
senses.example: He signed the wrong line in a moment of absence.
senses.exampleCN: 他一时分神，签错了行。
senses.why: The mind can be away while the body stays, and the word follows it.
senses.whyCN: 身体在而心可以不在，这个词便跟着心走。

senses.title: Official leave
senses.definition: in leave of absence, permission to be away from duty
senses.definitionCN: 在 leave of absence 中，指获准离开岗位
senses.example: She took a year's leave of absence to travel.
senses.exampleCN: 她请了一年假去旅行。
senses.why: An approved absence is still an absence, only a permitted one.
senses.whyCN: 获准的缺席仍是缺席，只是被允许了。

senses.title: A missing proof
senses.definition: in absence of evidence, the lack of proof for a claim
senses.definitionCN: 在 absence of evidence 中，指主张缺少证据
senses.example: The case failed for absence of evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 此案因证据缺失而未能成立。
senses.why: Law reasons from what is not there, and the word names that gap.
senses.whyCN: 法律会从「不存在的东西」推理，这个词便指那道缺口。

senses.title: Emotional distance
senses.definition: a felt lack of warmth or presence in a relationship
senses.definitionCN: 关系中缺少温暖或陪伴的感觉
senses.example: The child felt her father's absence even at home.
senses.exampleCN: 即使在家，孩子也能感到父亲的疏离。
senses.why: A person can be physically near and still absent in feeling.
senses.whyCN: 人可以身在近处，情感上却仍然缺席。

senses.title: Acting in someone's place
senses.definition: in in someone's absence, the time when another acts for them
senses.definitionCN: 在 in someone's absence 中，指由他人代为行事之时
senses.example: In the manager's absence, she signed the order.
senses.exampleCN: 经理不在时，她签了这份订单。
senses.why: The gap left by one person becomes the space where another acts.
senses.whyCN: 一个人留下的空位，成了另一个人行事的空间。

definition_zh: 缺席的；不在的；缺乏的；心不在焉的；使缺席
definition_en: not present in a place, or not existing
core_image: 一张写着自己名字却空着的座位牌
scene: 课堂上，老师念到他的名字，没有人应答。He was absent from class that morning.
sceneCN: 这里的 absent 指「缺席的」（第 1 个义项：不在场）；句意是那天上午他没来上课。

pos.zh: 缺席的；不在的；缺乏的；心不在焉的

senses.title: Not present
senses.definition: not in the place where one is expected
senses.definitionCN: 不在应当出现的地方
senses.example: He was absent from class that morning.
senses.exampleCN: 那天上午他没来上课。
senses.why: The Latin participle means being away, and this is its direct sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁分词意为「不在」，这是它最直接的义项。

senses.title: Not existing
senses.definition: not present in a thing or place
senses.definitionCN: 在某物或某处并不存在
senses.example: Certain minerals are absent from the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 这种土壤中缺少某些矿物质。
senses.why: What is away can also be simply not there at all.
senses.whyCN: 「不在」也可以干脆是根本不存在。

senses.title: Absent-minded
senses.definition: in absent-minded, not paying attention to what is around
senses.definitionCN: 在 absent-minded 中，指不注意周围事物
senses.example: He gave an absent-minded nod.
senses.exampleCN: 他心不在焉地点了点头。
senses.why: A mind that has wandered away leaves the body behind, and the compound names it.
senses.whyCN: 心思飘走了，身体留在原地，复合词便指这种状态。

senses.title: Away from duty
senses.definition: in absent without leave, away from a post without permission
senses.definitionCN: 在 absent without leave 中，指未经许可离开岗位
senses.example: The soldier was absent without leave for two days.
senses.exampleCN: 这名士兵擅离职守两天。
senses.why: Military language sharpens absence into an offence with a fixed phrase.
senses.whyCN: 军事用语把缺席收紧成一项罪，并固定成短语。

senses.title: Distant in manner
senses.definition: seems not fully engaged with the people around
senses.definitionCN: 看起来没有完全投入周围的人与事
senses.example: There was an absent look in her eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 她眼里有一种疏离的神情。
senses.why: Emotional absence shows on the face, so the adjective describes the look.
senses.whyCN: 情感上的缺席会写在脸上，形容词便描写这种神情。

senses.title: To stay away deliberately
senses.definition: in absent oneself, stays away on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 在 absent oneself 中，指有意避开
senses.example: She absented herself from the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 她故意没去开会。
senses.why: The rare verb turns the state into a chosen act.
senses.whyCN: 这个少见的动词把状态变成有意的行为。

senses.title: A parent who is not there
senses.definition: in absent father, a parent who does not live with or care for a child
senses.definitionCN: 在 absent father 中，指不与孩子同住或未尽照顾之责的父亲
senses.example: The study focused on children with an absent father.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究关注父亲缺位的孩子。
senses.why: Social writing uses the word for a role that goes unfilled rather than a body out of the room.
senses.whyCN: 社会写作把这个词用于无人承担的角色，而不只是人不在屋里。

senses.title: Not in court
senses.definition: in law, a party who does not appear when required
senses.definitionCN: 法律上指应到庭而未到的一方
senses.example: The court ruled against the absent defendant.
senses.exampleCN: 法院对缺席的被告作出判决。
senses.why: Legal procedure needs a word for the party who fails to appear.
senses.whyCN: 法律程序需要一个词来指未出庭的一方。

definition_zh: 绝对的；完全的；不受限制的；确实的
definition_en: complete and total, or not limited by anything else
core_image: 一把没有刻度的尺子，代表不受条件限制
scene: 在山顶看夜景，四周没有一盏灯，黑得彻底。The darkness on the mountain was absolute.
sceneCN: 这里的 absolute 指「完全的；彻底的」（第 1 个义项：毫无例外的整体程度）；句意是山上的黑暗是彻底的。

pos.zh: 绝对的；完全的；不受限制的

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成，义为「绝对地；完全地」
义为「专制主义；绝对主义」

senses.title: Complete and total
senses.definition: complete, with nothing left out or limited
senses.definitionCN: 完整无缺，没有任何遗漏或限制
senses.example: The darkness on the mountain was absolute.
senses.exampleCN: 山上的黑暗是彻底的。
senses.why: The Latin participle means freed, and something freed from limits is total.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁分词意为「被松开」，从限制中松开就是彻底。

senses.title: Unlimited power
senses.definition: describes authority with no check from another body
senses.definitionCN: 形容不受其他机构制约的权力
senses.example: The old kings claimed absolute power.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时的国王声称拥有绝对权力。
senses.why: Power released from every check is the political face of being freed from limits.
senses.whyCN: 摆脱一切制约的权力，正是「从限制中松开」的政治面貌。

senses.title: Absolute zero
senses.definition: the lowest temperature that is theoretically possible
senses.definitionCN: 理论上可能达到的最低温度
senses.example: At absolute zero, motion nearly stops.
senses.exampleCN: 在绝对零度，运动几乎停止。
senses.why: A scale with no negative values needs a true zero, and the word marks it.
senses.whyCN: 没有负值的刻度需要一个真正的零点，这个词便标出它。

senses.title: Absolute majority
senses.definition: more than half of all possible votes
senses.definitionCN: 超过全部可能票数的一半
senses.example: The bill passed by an absolute majority.
senses.exampleCN: 该法案以绝对多数通过。
senses.why: A majority counted against the whole, not just those present, is unconditional.
senses.whyCN: 以全体而非仅出席者为基数计算的多数，是不带条件的。

senses.title: Certain beyond doubt
senses.definition: so clear that no doubt remains
senses.definitionCN: 清楚得不容任何怀疑
senses.example: We have absolute proof of the link.
senses.exampleCN: 我们有确凿的证据证明这种联系。
senses.why: A proof set free from objection is absolute proof.
senses.whyCN: 摆脱了反驳的证据，就是确凿的证据。

senses.title: Not relative
senses.definition: in philosophy, existing without dependence on something else
senses.definitionCN: 哲学上指不依赖他物而存在
senses.example: Philosophers debate whether any value is absolute.
senses.exampleCN: 哲学家争论是否存在绝对的价值。
senses.why: The contrast with relative is the abstract core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 与「相对的」对照，正是这个词的抽象核心。

senses.title: A legal absolute right
senses.definition: a right that cannot be taken away by others
senses.definitionCN: 他人无法剥夺的权利
senses.example: The court treated it as an absolute right.
senses.exampleCN: 法院将其视为绝对权利。
senses.why: Law uses the word for a right free from exceptions.
senses.whyCN: 法律用这个词指没有例外的权利。

senses.title: The absolute in philosophy
senses.definition: in metaphysics, the ultimate reality that depends on nothing
senses.definitionCN: 形而上学中不依赖任何他物的终极实在
senses.example: Idealist systems begin from the absolute.
senses.exampleCN: 唯心主义体系从绝对者出发。
senses.why: The adjective became a noun for whatever is entirely unconditioned.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为名词，指完全无条件者。

definition_en: completely, or used to agree strongly in speech

scene: 朋友问她是否愿意帮忙，她回答得非常干脆。She said absolutely when asked to help.
sceneCN: 这里的 absolutely 指「当然；完全同意」（第 1 个义项：口语中表示强烈赞同）；句意是有人请她帮忙时，她一口答应了。

senses.title: Strong agreement
senses.definition: in speech, answers with complete agreement
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示毫无保留的赞同
senses.example: She said absolutely when asked to help.
senses.exampleCN: 有人请她帮忙时，她一口答应了。
senses.why: Full agreement is agreement without limit, so the adverb of completeness becomes a strong yes.
senses.whyCN: 完全同意就是没有保留的同意，表「完全」的副词便成了强有力的「是」。

senses.title: Completely
senses.definition: in a complete and total way
senses.definitionCN: 以完整、彻底的方式
senses.example: The room was absolutely silent.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里一片寂静。
senses.why: The adverb simply turns the adjective of completeness into a manner word.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词只是把表「完整」的形容词变成方式词。

senses.title: Certainly
senses.definition: used to state that something is certainly true
senses.definitionCN: 用来表示某事确实为真
senses.example: That is absolutely the best answer.
senses.exampleCN: 那确实是最好的答案。
senses.why: What is complete leaves no room for doubt, so the word also means certainly.
senses.whyCN: 完整的东西不留怀疑余地，因此这个词也表示确实。

senses.title: Not at all
senses.definition: in absolutely not, a firm refusal
senses.definitionCN: 在 absolutely not 中，表示坚决拒绝
senses.example: Absolutely not, we cannot bend the rule.
senses.exampleCN: 绝对不行，我们不能通融这条规则。
senses.why: The same intensity that affirms can also refuse, and the negative phrase carries it.
senses.whyCN: 肯定时的强度也能用于拒绝，否定短语便承载这种强度。

senses.title: Without limit
senses.definition: in a way that admits no exception
senses.definitionCN: 以不容例外的方式
senses.example: The right is absolutely protected by the charter.
senses.exampleCN: 这项权利受宪章绝对保护。
senses.why: Freedom from limits is the oldest sense of the root, and the adverb keeps it.
senses.whyCN: 摆脱限制是词根最古老的意思，副词把它保留下来。

senses.title: In absolute terms
senses.definition: measured without relation to other things
senses.definitionCN: 不与其他事物相对照地衡量
senses.example: Absolutely speaking, the gain is small.
senses.exampleCN: 从绝对数值来说，增幅很小。
senses.why: The word marks a measure taken on its own, apart from comparison.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标出不作比较、单独衡量的数值。

senses.title: An intensifier
senses.definition: in speech, strengthens an adjective or verb
senses.definitionCN: 口语中加强形容词或动词的语气
senses.example: It was absolutely freezing outside.
senses.exampleCN: 外面冷得要命。
senses.why: Completeness naturally serves as emphasis, which is why the word peppers conversation.
senses.whyCN: 「完全」天然可以表强调，因此这个词在口语里频繁出现。

senses.title: A grammatical absolute
senses.definition: in grammar, a phrase that stands apart from the main clause
senses.definitionCN: 语法上指与主句相对独立的短语
senses.example: The teacher explained the absolute construction in Latin.
senses.exampleCN: 老师讲解了拉丁语中的独立结构。
senses.why: A construction cut loose from the main clause carries the old sense of being freed.
senses.whyCN: 从主句上「松开」的结构，带着古老的「被释放」义。

definition_zh: 吸收；吸引；使专心；理解；合并
definition_en: to take in liquid, energy, information or attention
core_image: 一块海绵把桌上的水一点点吸进去
scene: 孩子把故事书抱在怀里，读得忘了吃饭。She was so absorbed in the story that she forgot dinner.
sceneCN: 这里的 absorb 指「使专心」（第 1 个义项：占据全部注意力）；句意是她读得太入迷，忘了晚饭。

senses.title: To hold attention completely
senses.definition: takes up all of someone's attention
senses.definitionCN: 占据某人的全部注意力
senses.example: She was so absorbed in the story that she forgot dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 她读得太入迷，忘了晚饭。
senses.why: Attention is drawn in the way a sponge draws water, which is the root image.
senses.whyCN: 注意力被吸进去，正如海绵吸水，这是词根的意象。

senses.title: To take in liquid
senses.definition: soaks up a liquid into itself
senses.definitionCN: 把液体吸进自身
senses.example: The cloth absorbed the spilled milk.
senses.exampleCN: 布吸干了洒出的牛奶。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to suck in, and liquid is its first object.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「吸进」，液体是它最早的对象。

senses.title: To take in energy
senses.definition: takes in light, heat or sound rather than reflecting it
senses.definitionCN: 吸收光、热或声，而不是把它们反射出去
senses.example: Dark surfaces absorb more heat than light ones.
senses.exampleCN: 深色表面比浅色表面吸收更多热量。
senses.why: The same sucking-in model applies to invisible things such as heat.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「吸进」模型适用于热这类看不见的东西。

senses.title: To understand and retain
senses.definition: takes in information and makes it one's own
senses.definitionCN: 接收信息并把它变成自己的
senses.example: Students need time to absorb the new material.
senses.exampleCN: 学生需要时间消化新材料。
senses.why: Knowledge is treated as something poured in and held, like liquid in cloth.
senses.whyCN: 知识被当作可以倒入并留住的东西，如同布中的水。

senses.title: To take over a group
senses.definition: makes a smaller organisation part of a larger one
senses.definitionCN: 使较小的组织并入较大的组织
senses.example: The bank absorbed two small rivals.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行吞并了两个小竞争对手。
senses.why: One body takes another into itself, and the word comes from physical soaking.
senses.whyCN: 一个实体把另一个纳入自身，这个词源自物理上的吸入。

senses.title: To use up time or money
senses.definition: takes up a share of time, money or effort
senses.definitionCN: 占去一部分时间、金钱或精力
senses.example: The repairs absorbed most of the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 维修耗去了大部分预算。
senses.why: A cost taken in leaves less of the whole, like liquid taken up by cloth.
senses.whyCN: 被吸走的成本使总量减少，如同布吸走液体。

senses.title: To soften an impact
senses.definition: takes the force of a blow and reduces it
senses.definitionCN: 承受冲击并使其减弱
senses.example: The thick mat absorbed the fall.
senses.exampleCN: 厚垫子缓冲了坠落。
senses.why: A blow taken into a material is no longer felt as a blow.
senses.whyCN: 冲击被材料吸收，就不再作为冲击被感觉到。

senses.title: To take in nutrients
senses.definition: in biology, takes nutrients through a surface
senses.definitionCN: 生物学上指通过表面吸收养分
senses.example: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 根从土壤中吸收水分和矿物质。
senses.why: Living tissue taking in what it needs is the biological face of soaking up.
senses.whyCN: 活组织摄入所需之物，正是「吸入」的生物学面貌。

definition_en: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing, or a short summary

scene: 美术馆里，一幅没有具体形象的画让人停下来看。The gallery showed an abstract painting with no clear subject.

senses.title: Not concrete
senses.definition: existing as an idea, not as a physical object
senses.definitionCN: 作为观念而存在，而非具体物体
senses.example: The gallery showed an abstract painting with no clear subject.
senses.exampleCN: 美术馆展出一幅没有明确主题的抽象画。
senses.why: The Latin participle means drawn away, and an idea drawn away from things is abstract.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁分词意为「被抽走」，从具体事物中抽出的观念就是抽象的。

senses.title: Abstract art
senses.definition: art that does not try to show real objects
senses.definitionCN: 不试图表现真实物体的艺术
senses.example: She prefers abstract to landscape painting.
senses.exampleCN: 比起风景画，她更喜欢抽象画。
senses.why: Art that draws away from likeness keeps the word for what has been removed.
senses.whyCN: 从形似中抽离的艺术，保留了这个「被抽走」的词。

senses.title: A summary
senses.definition: a short account of the main points of a paper
senses.definitionCN: 对论文要点的简短陈述
senses.example: Read the abstract before the full paper.
senses.exampleCN: 先读摘要，再读全文。
senses.why: A summary draws the essence out of a longer text.
senses.whyCN: 摘要就是把要点从长文中抽出来。

senses.title: To extract
senses.definition: takes something out of a larger mass
senses.definitionCN: 从较大的整体中取出某物
senses.example: The process abstracts metal from ore.
senses.exampleCN: 这道工序从矿石中提取金属。
senses.why: The literal sense of drawing away survives in chemistry and mining.
senses.whyCN: 「抽走」的字面义在化学与采矿中留存。

senses.title: In the abstract
senses.definition: in the phrase in the abstract, considered apart from real cases
senses.definitionCN: 在 in the abstract 中，指脱离具体事例来考虑
senses.example: In the abstract, the plan sounds fair.
senses.exampleCN: 从理论上说，这个计划听起来很公平。
senses.why: To consider apart from cases is to draw the idea away from them.
senses.whyCN: 脱离事例来考虑，就是把观念从事例中抽走。

senses.title: An abstract noun
senses.definition: a noun naming a quality or state rather than a thing
senses.definitionCN: 指称性质或状态而非物体的名词
senses.example: Freedom is an abstract noun.
senses.exampleCN: 自由是一个抽象名词。
senses.why: Grammar classifies words by whether they name something drawn away from matter.
senses.whyCN: 语法按是否指称脱离物质之物来分类名词。

senses.title: Lost in thought
senses.definition: in abstracted, with the mind drawn away from the present
senses.definitionCN: 在 abstracted 中，指心思离开了眼前
senses.example: He gave an abstracted reply and walked on.
senses.exampleCN: 他心不在焉地答了一句，继续往前走。
senses.why: A mind drawn away from the room is literally abstracted.
senses.whyCN: 心思被抽离房间，字面上就是被抽走。

senses.title: To remove in chemistry

senses.why: Chemical extraction is the modern technical heir of drawing something out.
senses.whyCN: 化学萃取正是「把某物抽出」的现代技术后裔。

definition_zh: 丰富；充裕；大量
definition_en: a very large quantity of something
core_image: 果园里压弯枝条的果子
scene: 秋收时，树上挂满果子，地上也落了一层。The orchard produced an abundance of apples that year.
sceneCN: 这里的 abundance 指「丰富；大量」（第 1 个义项：数量极多）；句意是那年果园的苹果获得了大丰收。

senses.title: A large quantity
senses.definition: a quantity much greater than enough
senses.definitionCN: 远超所需的数量
senses.example: The orchard produced an abundance of apples that year.
senses.exampleCN: 那年果园的苹果获得了大丰收。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to overflow like a wave, and overflowing is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「如波浪般溢出」，溢出正是核心义。

senses.title: Wealth of resources
senses.definition: the state of having more than one needs
senses.definitionCN: 拥有超过所需之物的状态
senses.example: The region is known for its abundance of water.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区以水资源丰富著称。
senses.why: A land that overflows with goods is called rich, and the noun names that plenty.
senses.whyCN: 物产 overflow 的地方被称作富庶，名词便指这种丰足。

senses.title: In abundance
senses.definition: in the phrase in abundance, existing in large amounts
senses.definitionCN: 在 in abundance 中，指大量存在
senses.example: Fish were found in abundance along the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 沿海一带鱼非常多。
senses.why: The preposition turns the noun into a measure of how something occurs.
senses.whyCN: 介词把名词变成描述事物出现方式的量度。

senses.title: Biological abundance
senses.definition: in ecology, the number of individuals in an area
senses.definitionCN: 生态学上指某地区的个体数量
senses.example: The survey measured the abundance of bees.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查测量了蜜蜂的丰度。
senses.why: Science counts how much life fills a place, extending the old idea of plenty.
senses.whyCN: 科学计量一地生物之多，延续了古老的「丰盛」观念。

senses.title: An abundance of caution
senses.definition: in the phrase an abundance of caution, more care than usual
senses.definitionCN: 在 an abundance of caution 中，指超乎寻常的谨慎
senses.example: The bridge was closed out of an abundance of caution.
senses.exampleCN: 出于格外谨慎，这座桥被关闭了。
senses.why: Even a quality can be had in excess, and the phrase names that excess.
senses.whyCN: 连品质也可以过量，短语便指这种过量。

senses.title: Emotional abundance
senses.definition: a generous flow of feeling or kindness
senses.definitionCN: 情感或善意的充沛流露
senses.example: She greeted every guest with warmth and abundance.
senses.exampleCN: 她以温暖而充沛的热情迎接每位客人。
senses.why: What overflows need not be material, so the noun covers feeling too.
senses.whyCN: 溢出的不必是物质，名词也涵盖情感。

senses.title: An abundance mentality
senses.definition: the belief that there is enough for everyone
senses.definitionCN: 相信资源足够所有人分享的心态
senses.example: The team works well because of its abundance mentality.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队合作良好，靠的是富足心态。
senses.why: A modern coinage treats plenty as a way of seeing the world.
senses.whyCN: 现代新造说法把「丰足」当成一种看世界的方式。

senses.title: Elemental abundance
senses.definition: in chemistry, how common an element is in a sample
senses.definitionCN: 化学上指某元素在样本中的常见程度
senses.example: The spectrograph reported the abundance of iron.
senses.exampleCN: 光谱仪报出了铁的丰度。
senses.why: Measuring how much of an element is present is another technical branch of plenty.
senses.whyCN: 测量某元素存在多少，是「丰盛」的另一技术分支。

definition_zh: 丰富的；充裕的；大量的；茂盛的
definition_en: existing in large quantities, more than enough
core_image: 果园枝头被果子压弯，落果铺了一地
scene: 秋天走进果园，枝头的果子多得几乎垂到地面。The orchard was abundant with fruit that autumn.
sceneCN: 这里的 abundant 指「丰富的」（第 1 个义项：数量极多）；句意是那年秋天果园里果实累累。

senses.title: Existing in great number
senses.definition: is present in large numbers or amounts
senses.definitionCN: 以很大的数量或分量存在
senses.example: Fish were abundant in the clear lake.
senses.exampleCN: 清澈的湖里鱼很多。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to overflow, and plenty is the first thing overflow gives.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「溢出」，溢出首先带来的就是丰盛。

senses.title: Rich in a quality
senses.definition: contains a quality in large measure
senses.definitionCN: 大量含有某种特质
senses.example: The region is abundant in minerals.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区矿产丰富。
senses.why: Overflow can be of anything, so the word also measures qualities.
senses.whyCN: 溢出之物可以是任何东西，因此这个词也用来衡量品质。

senses.title: More than enough
senses.definition: is more than enough for a need
senses.definitionCN: 超过所需，十分充足
senses.example: We had abundant time to prepare.
senses.exampleCN: 我们有充裕的时间做准备。
senses.why: A wave that spills over the rim is the image of surplus.
senses.whyCN: 漫过边缘的浪，正是「有余」的意象。

senses.title: Rich in words
senses.definition: in writing, is full and generous in expression
senses.definitionCN: 在写作中表达充分而丰沛
senses.example: Her abundant prose filled every page.
senses.exampleCN: 她丰沛的文笔写满了每一页。
senses.why: Language can overflow too, and the word describes a full style.
senses.whyCN: 语言也会溢出，这个词便用来形容饱满的文风。

senses.title: Generous in amount
senses.definition: is given in a generous quantity, as rain or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 如雨水或情感，给得十分大方
senses.example: Abundant rain saved the harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 充沛的雨水挽救了收成。
senses.why: Nature's gifts that come in excess are called abundant.
senses.whyCN: 自然给的过多恩赐，就被称作 abundant。

senses.title: Growing thickly
senses.definition: of plants, grows thick and healthy
senses.definitionCN: 指植物长得茂密健壮
senses.example: Abundant grass covered the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 茂盛的草覆盖着山坡。
senses.why: A field that overflows with growth shows the same image.
senses.whyCN: 长满草木的田野呈现的是同一个意象。

senses.title: Full of life
senses.definition: in religious or poetic use, means full and rich in life
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教或诗意用法中，指生命充实丰盈
senses.example: They spoke of abundant life as a gift.
senses.exampleCN: 他们谈论丰盛的生命，视之为恩赐。
senses.why: Overflow becomes a metaphor for a life that lacks nothing.
senses.whyCN: 溢出成了「一无所缺的生活」的隐喻。

senses.title: An abundant number
senses.definition: in mathematics, is a number smaller than the sum of its divisors
senses.definitionCN: 数学上指小于其真因数之和的数
senses.example: Twelve is an abundant number.
senses.exampleCN: 十二是一个过剩数。
senses.why: The divisors add up beyond the number itself, an exact overflow.
senses.whyCN: 因数之和超过了这个数本身，正是一种精确的溢出。

definition_zh: 滥用；虐待；辱骂；恶习
definition_en: the wrong or harmful use of something, or cruel treatment of a person
core_image: 一只手把权力的印章用力按在别人的文件上
scene: 他把手里的权力当成使唤别人的工具，动不动就发号施令。The manager was accused of abuse of power.
sceneCN: 这里的 abuse 指「滥用」（第 1 个义项：不正当地使用权力或物品）；句意是这位经理被指控滥用职权。

senses.title: Wrong use of power
senses.definition: uses a power or right wrongly or for harm
senses.definitionCN: 不正当地、以致害的方式使用权力或权利
senses.example: He was removed for abuse of office.
senses.exampleCN: 他因滥用职权被免职。
senses.why: The Latin verb joins away with use, so using wrongly is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词把「偏离」与「使用」合在一起，用得不对正是最古老的意思。

senses.title: Cruel treatment
senses.definition: treats a person or animal cruelly
senses.definitionCN: 残忍地对待人或动物
senses.example: The charity fights the abuse of children.
senses.exampleCN: 这家慈善机构致力于打击虐待儿童。
senses.why: Treating a person as a thing to be used is a misuse of the person.
senses.whyCN: 把人当作可使用之物，就是在误用这个人。

senses.title: Insulting language
senses.definition: speaks to someone in coarse and hurtful words
senses.definitionCN: 用粗鲁伤人的话对某人说话
senses.example: The player was fined for abuse of the referee.
senses.exampleCN: 那名球员因辱骂裁判被罚款。
senses.why: Words used to wound are words used for the wrong purpose.
senses.whyCN: 用来伤人的话，就是被用错了用途的话。

senses.title: Misuse of a substance
senses.definition: uses drugs or alcohol harmfully
senses.definitionCN: 以有害的方式使用药物或酒精
senses.example: The clinic treats alcohol abuse.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所治疗酗酒问题。
senses.why: A medicine used beyond its purpose becomes an abuse.
senses.whyCN: 药超出用途去使用，就成了一种滥用。

senses.title: Sexual harm
senses.definition: in law, refers to sexual contact without consent
senses.definitionCN: 法律上指未经同意的性接触
senses.example: The law punishes the abuse of minors.
senses.exampleCN: 法律惩处侵害未成年人的行为。
senses.why: The word's sense of harmful use covers the gravest misuse of a person.
senses.whyCN: 这个词「有害使用」的含义，涵盖了对人最严重的侵害。

senses.title: A harmful practice
senses.definition: names a widespread wrong custom or fault
senses.definitionCN: 指普遍存在的错误做法或积弊
senses.example: The report exposed abuses in the system.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭露了这一制度中的弊端。
senses.why: Repeated misuse hardens into a custom, and the plural names such faults.
senses.whyCN: 反复的误用会固化成习俗，复数便指这些积弊。

senses.title: To take advantage of
senses.definition: treats someone as a tool for one's own gain
senses.definitionCN: 把某人当作谋取私利的工具
senses.example: He abused the trust of his friends.
senses.exampleCN: 他辜负并利用了朋友们的信任。
senses.why: Using a person as a means is the verb's clearest modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 把人当手段，是这个动词最清楚的现代义。

senses.title: To scold harshly
senses.definition: speaks to someone with angry and rude words
senses.definitionCN: 用愤怒粗鲁的话责骂某人
senses.example: Do not abuse the staff at the counter.
senses.exampleCN: 不要辱骂柜台的工作人员。
senses.why: The verbal branch of the noun repeats as a verb of scolding.
senses.whyCN: 名词里「言语」这一支，作动词时便是责骂。

definition_zh: 学术的；学院的；纯理论的；大学教师
definition_en: relating to study, schools and research rather than practical use
core_image: 长袍学者在庭院里围着一块写满公式的黑板
scene: 图书馆里，学生们围着一堆论文争论研究方法是否可靠。Her academic work was praised by the committee.
sceneCN: 这里的 academic 指「学术的」（第 1 个义项：与学习和研究相关的）；句意是她的学术工作得到了委员会的称赞。

pos.zh: 学术的；学院的；纯理论的

senses.title: Relating to study
senses.definition: belongs to study, teaching and research
senses.definitionCN: 属于学习、教学与研究领域
senses.example: The journal publishes academic work.
senses.exampleCN: 这份期刊发表学术成果。
senses.why: The word comes from the name of Plato's school, where study was the whole point.
senses.whyCN: 这个词出自柏拉图学园之名，那里的一切都是为了研究。

senses.title: Relating to a college
senses.definition: belongs to a college or university
senses.definitionCN: 属于学院或大学
senses.example: The academic buildings stand around the square.
senses.exampleCN: 教学建筑环绕着广场。
senses.why: A school needs a name for what belongs to it, and academic supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 学校需要一个词来指属于它的东西，academic 正好补上。

senses.title: Not practical
senses.definition: concerns theory rather than real use
senses.definitionCN: 关乎理论而非实际应用
senses.example: The debate is academic until we have data.
senses.exampleCN: 在拿到数据之前，这场争论只是纸上谈兵。
senses.why: Study for its own sake can seem far from use, so the word came to mean theoretical.
senses.whyCN: 为研究而研究看似远离实用，于是这个词有了「理论性」之义。

senses.title: A university teacher
senses.definition: as a noun, a person who teaches and researches
senses.definitionCN: 作名词时，指从事教学与研究的人
senses.example: Several academics signed the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 几位大学教师在这封信上签了名。
senses.why: The adjective used as a noun names a member of the academic body.
senses.whyCN: 形容词用作名词，便指学术群体中的一员。

senses.title: Relating to a subject
senses.definition: in academic subject, means a subject taught at school
senses.definitionCN: 在 academic subject 中，指学校开设的学科
senses.example: History is an academic subject.
senses.exampleCN: 历史是一门学科。
senses.why: What the school teaches is by definition part of its academic life.
senses.whyCN: 学校所教的内容，按定义就属于它的学术生活。

senses.title: Relating to the school year
senses.definition: in academic year, means the year of study
senses.definitionCN: 在 academic year 中，指教学年度
senses.example: The academic year starts in September.
senses.exampleCN: 学年在九月开始。
senses.why: Time at a school is measured by its own calendar, marked with this word.
senses.whyCN: 学校里的时间按自己的历法计量，就用这个词来标记。

senses.title: Of no practical importance
senses.definition: describes a question whose answer changes nothing
senses.definitionCN: 形容一个答案不改变任何事的问题
senses.example: Whether we call it a city is academic.
senses.exampleCN: 我们叫它城市与否并无实际意义。
senses.why: A purely academic question lives only in the study, not in the world.
senses.whyCN: 纯粹学术的问题只活在书房里，不在现实之中。

senses.title: Worn for ceremonies
senses.definition: in academic dress, means the gown worn at ceremonies
senses.definitionCN: 在 academic dress 中，指典礼上穿的长袍
senses.example: The graduates wore academic dress.
senses.exampleCN: 毕业生们穿着学位服。
senses.why: The medieval school gave its members a costume, and the word still names it.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪的学校给成员规定了服装，这个词至今仍指它。

intro.en: The word carries the name of the grove where Plato taught.
intro.cn: 这个词携带着柏拉图授课那片园子的名字。

items.en: Akademeia named a grove outside Athens sacred to a hero.
items.cn: Akademeia 指雅典城外一片献给某位英雄的园子。

items.en: Plato taught in that grove, and his school took its name.
items.cn: 柏拉图在那片园中授课，他的学派便以此得名。

items.en: academia named the school of philosophy.
items.cn: academia 指这所哲学学园。

items.en: academique described what belonged to that school.
items.cn: academique 形容属于该学园的事物。

items.en: academic entered English meaning of a college.
items.cn: academic 进入英语，意为「学院的」。

items.en: it now covers study itself and things of no practical use.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖学术研究本身，也指没有实际用途的事物。

note.en: The look-alike group is the academy family; the near-meaning group is words for learning and theory.
note.cn: 形近组是 academy 词族；近义组是表示治学与理论的词。

abstract.en: See a chalk board covered with long equations.
abstract.cn: 想象一块写满长串公式的黑板。

abstract.en: Picture students arguing over a paper on a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象学生们围着长桌争论一篇论文。

abstract.en: Think of a gown folded on a chair before a ceremony.
abstract.cn: 想象典礼前搭在椅子上的长袍。

examples.en: His academic record is strong.
examples.cn: 他的学业成绩很出色。

examples.cn: 那个问题现在已纯属纸上谈兵。

sensesIntro.cn: 一片治学的园子，分出学院、理论、教师、学科与长袍等分支。

definition_zh: 学院；专科学校；研究院；学会
definition_en: a school for special training, or a society of scholars and artists
core_image: 石砌大门上刻着院徽，学生抱着乐谱走进去
scene: 街角那栋老楼门口挂着铜牌，里面传出练琴的声音。She trained at the national academy for three years.
sceneCN: 这里的 academy 指「专科学校」（第 1 个义项：专门培养某种技能的学校）；句意是她在国家级的学院受训三年。

pos.zh: 学院；专科学校；研究院；学会

senses.title: A training school
senses.definition: a school that trains people in a special skill
senses.definitionCN: 专门培养某种技能的学校
senses.example: He studied at a music academy.
senses.exampleCN: 他在一所音乐学院学习。
senses.why: A grove of study became a place of specialised teaching, and that is the first modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 治学的园子成了专门授课之处，这是第一个现代义项。

senses.title: A society of scholars
senses.definition: an honoured body of scholars or artists
senses.definitionCN: 由学者或艺术家组成的荣誉团体
senses.example: The academy elects ten new members a year.
senses.exampleCN: 该学会每年遴选十名新成员。
senses.why: Plato's group was a company of thinkers, and later societies kept the word.
senses.whyCN: 柏拉图的团体是一群思想者，后来的学会沿用了这个词。

senses.title: A military school
senses.definition: a college that trains officers
senses.definitionCN: 培养军官的高等学校
senses.example: He entered the military academy at eighteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十八岁进入军事学院。
senses.why: An officer's training is a special skill, so the word fits military schools.
senses.whyCN: 军官训练也是一种专门技能，因此这个词也适用于军校。

senses.title: A school of art
senses.definition: a college for painting, music or drama
senses.definitionCN: 教授绘画、音乐或戏剧的院校
senses.example: The academy holds a show every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这所艺术院校每年春天举办展览。
senses.why: Art too is taught in a special school, and the word covers it.
senses.whyCN: 艺术也在专门的学校里教授，这个词自然涵盖它。

senses.title: A film prize
senses.definition: in academy award, the prize given by a film academy
senses.definitionCN: 在 academy award 中，指由电影学院颁发的奖项
senses.example: She won an academy award for the film.
senses.exampleCN: 她凭这部影片赢得了学院奖。
senses.why: A body of film makers is an academy, and its prize took the name.
senses.whyCN: 电影从业者的团体就是一个学院，它的奖项便沿用了这个名字。

senses.title: A secondary school
senses.definition: in Scotland and the United States, a school for older pupils
senses.definitionCN: 在苏格兰与美国，指招收较大学生的中学
senses.example: The academy in our town takes pupils from twelve to eighteen.
senses.exampleCN: 我们镇上的中学招收十二到十八岁的学生。
senses.why: Older schools kept the old name after they became local secondary schools.
senses.whyCN: 一些老学校在变成地方中学后，仍保留了这个旧名。

senses.title: Plato's school
senses.definition: the school of philosophy founded by Plato
senses.definitionCN: 柏拉图创立的哲学学派
senses.example: The academy lasted for centuries after Plato.
senses.exampleCN: 柏拉图之后，这所学园延续了数百年。
senses.why: The original academy is the historical source of every later sense.
senses.whyCN: 最初的学园是所有后世义项的历史源头。

senses.title: A private learned body
senses.definition: a private society that promotes an art or science
senses.definitionCN: 推动某门艺术或科学的私人团体
senses.example: The academy publishes its own journal.
senses.exampleCN: 这个学术团体出版自己的期刊。
senses.why: Societies that fund and publish research borrow the dignified old name.
senses.whyCN: 资助并出版研究的团体，借用了这个庄重的旧名。
